name: the-orange
provenance: Chosen by Nathan, 2026-08-30, as the founding scene of the repertory: 'a goblin and a drow in a room and the drow is trying to convince the goblin to give him a particularly ripe orange.' Expected DECLARED for several campaigns; its beats are the arc's task list.

scenes.title: A drow wants a ripe orange that a goblin has
scenes.declared: Expected UNWITNESSED rather than ABSENT, and the distinction is the point. The capabilities beat 2 needs now EXIST -- The Chattel put carried things on the wire and The Company put the co-located half on sensed.present -- so this scene is no longer blocked on the program. It is blocked on the WORLD: SOC-one-creature-per-settlement records that a settlement holds exactly one derived creature, so the pairs that do share a room are wild concentrations, never a drow and a goblin. Nathan already ruled that changing world population to restore co-location is its own campaign, since The Penstock measured tick cost superlinear in that dimension. What remains beyond the stage is that no verb addresses another creature. Delete this declaration the moment the scene passes -- STALE-DECL will insist.

beats.description: a drow and a goblin share a room, and the drow can tell
the goblin is holding something that can change hands
